headline: True friendship is one of the most reliable predictors of happiness and longevity
universal_truth: We are built for connection; isolation is not just lonely—it's unhealthy
fun_facts: Having strong friendships can increase your lifespan by up to 50%—more than exercise or diet
The average person has only 2-3 truly close friends, despite knowing hundreds of people
It takes about 50 hours of interaction to move from acquaintance to casual friend, and 200 hours to become close friends
discussion_questions: What qualities do you most value in a friend?
Who has shown up for you when it was hard for them?
Are you the kind of friend you want to have?

hook.title: Welcome
hook.script: You've probably heard that diet and exercise determine your health. But research shows something more powerful: your friendships. Having close friends can increase your lifespan more than quitting smoking. Today, we explore why connection is medicine.

options.text: I want to learn something new
options.response: Perfect. Curiosity is the first step to understanding. Let's explore this together.
That curiosity is exactly what we need. Let's dive in and discover something amazing.

cliff.title: The Question
cliff.script: We know hundreds of people, but most of us have only 2 or 3 truly close friends. What separates an acquaintance from someone you'd call at 3 AM when everything falls apart?
cliff.prompt: What transforms an acquaintance into a true friend?

options.text: Time spent together and shared experiences
options.response: Yes. Research shows it takes about 200 hours of interaction to build a close friendship.
Similarities help, but they're not enough alone...

q1.title: Friendship as Medicine
q1.script: A meta-analysis of 148 studies found that strong social relationships increase survival odds by 50%. That's comparable to quitting smoking and greater than the impact of obesity or lack of exercise. Loneliness, on the other hand, is as deadly as smoking 15 cigarettes a day.
q1.prompt: What's your first impression of "Friendship as Medicine"?

options.text: This confirms what I already knew
options.response: Great foundation! Now let's build on that knowledge with something you might not expect...
Perfect starting point! This insight will connect to even more surprising facts ahead.

q2.title: The 200-Hour Rule
q2.script: Researcher Jeffrey Hall found it takes roughly 50 hours of time together to move from acquaintance to casual friend. To become a close friend? About 200 hours. There are no shortcuts to deep connection—just shared time.
q2.prompt: How does this connect to what you already know?

options.response: Exactly. These connections are how knowledge becomes understanding.

options.text: I need to think about this more
options.response: That's a good instinct. Deep understanding takes time. The next fact will help clarify.

q3.title: Quality Over Quantity
q3.script: Despite social media giving us thousands of 'friends,' the average person has only 2-3 truly close confidants. This number has stayed remarkably stable across cultures and centuries. We're wired for a small inner circle.
q3.prompt: What surprises you most about this?

options.text: I never thought about it this way
options.response: That shift in perspective is exactly the point. New angles reveal new truths.
That's learning in action. When understanding shifts, you're really getting it.

wisdom.title: Today's Wisdom
wisdom.script: Here's today's wisdom: Friendship isn't about finding perfect people—it's about imperfect people who show up anyway. The best friends are those who know your flaws and stay. Who see you clearly and love you still.
wisdom.prompt: What resonates most with you today?

options.response: That central truth will stay with you. Let it guide your thinking.
Application is where knowledge becomes wisdom. That's the real learning.

outro.title: See You Tomorrow
outro.script: That's Day 8. Tomorrow, we'll discover how a single act of kindness ripples outward. Until then, consider reaching out to someone who matters to you.
outro.prompt: Before you go—what will you take from today?

options.response: Reflection deepens learning. Let these ideas simmer in your mind.
Teaching others is the best way to learn. You've already begun the ripple.

growTrack.title: Connection - Reaching Out
growTrack.learning_objective: Strengthen an existing friendship through intentional action
growTrack.activity: Send a message to one friend you haven't connected with in a while. Don't ask for anything—just tell them one thing you appreciate about them. Watch what happens.
